notes: Gest Street crosses the B. & O. S. W. railroad on an iron bridge at the west (x 700-1000) and continues off the sheet both ways; it slopes from y=628 at x=500 to y=529 at x=3917. West 9th Street east of Garrard is covered by a pasted correction showing the Buskirk Mill & Lumber Co. yard and its sawing/lumber building across the old street line, so Garrard/West 9th is recorded as a T from the west. The patch still carries 'W. 9TH' east of Garrard and a 50' label at the Horne end (x~3860, y~3290), and the north face of the yard there is a line at y=3377 from x=3472 east, so a 50' remnant of 9th may survive from Horne west to about x=3470. No closing line was found, so nothing is recorded for it. Horne Street runs along the east paper edge: its west face is at x~3870 and the paper ends at x~3945, so with a 50' width its centreline (x~3960) is off the sheet and the Horne crossings with Gest (y~529), Richmond (y~2441), 9th (y~3291) and 8th (y~4188) are not recorded. West 8th: block faces y~4000 and ~4380, viaduct structure lines y~4100 and ~4350, centre from the block faces. The curved line west of block 1 and the slanted line across block 2 are lot lines, not streets. Garrard has a railroad siding along its east side south of 9th (ignored).
